title: Kobo can run apps now
summary: Cobalt is an open-source project that enables Kobo e-readers to run custom applications, expanding their limited functionality beyond the stock firmware. The project provides a framework for sideloading and executing apps on these e-ink devices, giving users more freedom with their hardware.
problem_solved: Solves the limitation of Kobo e-readers being restricted to vendor-provided reading functionality by enabling custom app execution.
why_valuable: Gives users freedom to customize and extend their e-reader devices, potentially prolonging device usefulness and enabling personalized features.
